full_prompt_en: A square, polished cartoon illustration shows a gray cat and a small brown mouse interacting against a plain coral-pink background. The backdrop is a smooth warm field, with a faint ground plane suggested only by the soft shadows beneath their feet. On the left, the cat stands upright with a rounded gray body, pale belly, and broad white paws. Tall pink ears rise above a tufted dark head, and wide yellow eyes look toward the mouse. A pale muzzle and black whiskers project to the right, while the open smile gives the face a light mischievous expression. One arm bends at the side, and the other paw lifts toward the center as if responding to the smaller figure. A long thin tail curves behind the cat near the left edge. On the right, the mouse faces the cat, much shorter and lighter in color. Oversized round ears have pink interiors, and a thin curved tail trails toward the right edge. The mouse holds a small yellow wedge of cheese marked with orange holes near its chest, its head tipped upward toward the cat. Smooth gray, cream, and warm brown forms are shaped with gentle tonal gradients, while the eyes, noses, and whiskers remain crisp and graphic. At the lower-right corner, a tiny white cursive signature-like mark sits apart from the figures. Soft even studio-like lighting brightens the upper surfaces and leaves short, diffuse contact shadows below, without a dramatic directional beam. The overall composition is simple and playful, balancing two unequal character silhouettes against generous pink negative space and letting their exchanged gestures carry the scene.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、精细润饰的卡通插画描绘一只灰猫和一只小棕鼠在纯净的珊瑚粉背景前互动。背景是一整片平滑暖色，地面仅由脚下的柔软阴影稍作暗示。左侧，猫直立着，身体圆润呈灰色，腹部浅淡，白色爪子宽大。高高的粉色耳朵从带尖毛的深色头顶竖起，黄色大眼睛望向老鼠。浅色口鼻部和黑色胡须朝右伸出，张开的笑口使表情显得轻快狡黠。一只手臂在身边弯曲，另一只爪子向中央抬起，像是在回应较小的同伴。细长尾巴在左边缘附近从猫身后弯过。右侧，老鼠面向猫，身形小得多，颜色也更浅。过大的圆耳朵里是粉色，细弯尾巴拖向右缘。老鼠胸前拿着一小块带橙色孔洞的黄奶酪，头向上仰望猫。平滑的灰、奶油色和暖棕形体由轻柔明暗渐变塑造，眼睛、鼻子与胡须则保持清晰的图形感。右下角有一小道白色手写签名般的笔迹，独立于人物之外。柔和均匀的影棚式光照亮上表面，在脚下留下短而漫散的接触阴影，没有戏剧性的定向光束。整体构图简单而活泼，让大小悬殊的两个角色剪影在宽裕的粉色留白中平衡，以互相回应的手势承载情节。
style_prompt_en: The cartoon illustration uses rounded, elastic silhouettes, crisp facial accents, and smooth softly shaded color. Large uncluttered background areas make the compact focal group immediately legible. Charcoal gray and warm brown masses are separated by pale cream highlights, pink accents, and small yellow details, all held within a friendly high-key palette. Edges are clean and graphic, but slight tonal gradients give the bodies a plush three-dimensional softness. Oversized circular features and expressive angled lines carry emotion with few marks. Lighting is broad and even, leaving only short diffuse grounding shadows rather than strong environmental contrast. A clear difference in scale creates a lively conversational rhythm across the center. The overall effect is buoyant and approachable, blending classic cartoon shape design with gently polished modern rendering.
style_prompt_zh: 卡通插画运用圆润而有弹性的剪影、清晰的面部重音和平滑柔和的明暗色彩。大片不拥挤的背景让紧凑的焦点群组立即可读。炭灰与暖棕色体块由浅奶油色亮部、粉色重音和细小黄颜色块分开，整体维持亲切的高明度配色。边缘干净而具有图形感，细微渐变又给形体带来毛绒般的立体柔度。放大的圆形特征与带角度的表现线条用很少的笔迹传达情绪。光照宽泛均匀，只留下短而漫散的贴地阴影，没有强烈的环境对比。明显的尺度差异在中心形成活泼的对话节奏。整体效果轻快而易于亲近，把经典卡通形状设计与轻柔润饰的现代渲染结合起来。
theme_en: A gray cartoon cat and a small brown mouse with a wedge of cheese
theme_zh: 一只灰色卡通猫与拿着奶酪的小棕鼠
name: Tom and Jerry
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
